items.title: CenterPoint Energy (CNP) Reports Strong Q2 And Completes $700 Million Debt Offering
items.summary: CenterPoint Energy (NYSE:CNP) reported Q2 2026 results that the company described as strong. The utility expanded its 10-year capital plan, signaling a larger investment program for its regulated operations. CenterPoint Energy completed a US$700 million fixed-income offering with updated terms that extend its long-term funding profile.
